name: Witjira National Park
objection: Rule 1+2: Flinders & Outback outback page (opened) features Dalhousie Springs (swim in 37C artesian springs) and Mount Dare camping in Witjira.

name: Dalhousie Springs
objection: 2 counted sources, 3117 page views

name: Malkumba–Coongie Lakes National Park
objection: Rule 1+2: Flinders & Outback park page (opened) calls it one of SA's most spectacular natural attractions: arid wetland, birds, canoeing; 4WD access. Keeps the Coongie Lakes duplicate as this one.

name: Innamincka Regional Reserve
objection: parks.sa.gov.au visitor page: 1.3 million ha reserve with Cooper Creek waterholes for fishing and canoeing, Cullyamurra Waterhole, the visitor centre and Burke and Wills sites; Flinders & Outback also names it. Objection: parts closed in floods and it overlaps Cullyamurra.

name: Cullyamurra Waterhole
objection: Rule 1+2: Flinders & Outback (opened) names Australia's largest billabong as a canoe/paddle destination on Cooper Creek, significant to the Traditional Owners.

name: Elizabeth Symon Nursing Home
objection: Wikivoyage Innamincka See lists it, and the parks.sa.gov.au page says the heritage-listed park headquarters and interpretation centre (the former Australian Inland Mission building, i.e. the nursing home) is always open in the town centre, with natural history and Burke and Wills displays. Objection: more an information centre than a sight.
